# Filter players whose 'years for jazz' start after 2000
df['start_year'] = df['years for jazz'].str.extract(r'(\d{4})').astype(int)
df_after_2000 = df[df['start_year'] > 2000]

# Count players by nationality for the specified countries
countries = ['england', 'united states', 'brazil', 'puerto rico']
counts = df_after_2000[df_after_2000['nationality'].isin(counts)]['nationality'].value_counts()

# Check if each country has exactly 1 player
answer = all(counts.get(country, 0) == 1 for country in countries)
